intent: Connect the ten load-bearing metabolic mechanisms through one declared portfolio, an exactly-ten-node semantic A2A rehearsal cycle, independently checked completion promotion, causal cross-feeds, and one operator page per node. Decompose the implementation beneath the repository module budget and fail closed on malformed structured evidence while preserving the distinction between transport acknowledgement, local mutable-receipt consistency, and externally authenticated effects.

gates.name: autocatalytic-portfolio-tests
gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_autocatalytic_portfolio.py tests/test_manifest_health.py tests/test_a2a.py tests/test_catalytic_graph.py

commit.message: feat(organism): wire ten-node autocatalytic A2A portfolio

interface_mismatches: This P1 packet supersedes the uncommitted P0 implementation envelope because repository Rule 10 requires three admitted submodules; the P0 packet and its preflight binding are historical evidence only and cannot authorize this branch.
The declared ten-track ceiling is not evidence that those are the ten metabolic nodes; executable producer-consumer evidence and project adapters justify the node boundaries.

Existing A2A transport and idempotency acknowledgements can overstate nonterminal task completion, so this packet adds stricter independent structural and local-consistency result types without changing the A2A substrate.
Cross-feed observation alone is not causation, so target adapters must consume typed feed state and perturbation tests must prove the dependency.
Structured project receipts must parse and replay their declared digest; raw Markdown and JSONL sources remain explicitly content-addressed without being misrepresented as receipt JSON.
Three required membranes are not production-live and remain projection_only or external_gated until their declared proof obligations pass.

The PR-level AgentOps checker admits exactly one Session Entry packet for a high-risk range, so post-implementation DocOps and CI hardening remain consolidated under this merge-base-bound packet rather than separate tracked packets.

The repository-wide quality ratchet counts every modified Python module over 500 lines, so the implementation must be split into behavior-preserving submodules without changing its public facade, fingerprint coverage, or authority semantics.

Generated DocOps counts belong to post-merge reconciliation and are forbidden in this PR; changed architecture prose must instead pass the strict canonical-claim delta check without claiming a new documentation owner.
honest_blockers: No outbound publication or external effect is authorized or claimed by a local rehearsal cycle.
Independent provider-backed peers, authenticated execution provenance, and JetStream domain completion remain separate future live-contact gates.
The required qwen3-coder:480b-cloud review lane is retired upstream and any Kimi fallback cannot satisfy Qwen-family decorrelation.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped commit; runtime witnesses under ~/.dharma remain immutable evidence and are not doctrine.
